main.metric_naming: the 'historical' policy is a historical execution recall (row-set recall over common columns), not a strict execution accuracy; the canonical exact metric is 'exact_result_set_match_pct' (exact gold column list + row multiset + order when the gold query is ordered); 'common_column_exact_overlap_pct' is the LEGACY lenient exact over common columns only and is kept for comparison
